approvedContract.implementationBoundary: Private stable max-two anchor/depot cache, private lifecycle counters, and an internal pre-use per-tick reference mode; exact grid reference, rules version, Godot Vector3, and resolved-origin-cell identity; arbitrary citizen origins remain per-tick.

productionBehavior: Default mode retains immutable geometric distance fields across ticks only for exact settlement-anchor or central-depot origins.
Stable identity requires ReferenceEquals on the navigation grid, equal navigation-rules version, exact Godot Vector3 equality, and equal resolved origin grid cell.

The stable domain is two deterministic named slots: exact settlement anchor and exact central depot. Identical exact positions and resolved cells coalesce to one entry; replacing either distinct slot retains the other valid slot, and arbitrary or moving origins remain per-tick.
RebuildNavigation, rules invalidation, LoadState restore, fresh simulation construction, and ClearDerivedPathCacheForPerformance clear the relevant derived field caches.
The internal reference mode is selectable only before first field lookup and clears the stable domain at every tick boundary.
Stable hit, build, and clear counters and the cache probe are private or internal test-only surfaces.
